name: Darley Park Play Area
description: Riverside park in Darley Abbey with a play area run by Derby City Council. In 2025 the council planned to rebuild the play area as a heritage-themed space, subject to a National Lottery bid.

sources.label: Derby City Council: improvement project planned for Darley Park (March 2025)
